errors.text_span: with visible numeric tick labels ranging from 0 to 80
errors.evidence: This description is ambiguous because while the visible tick labels range from 0 to 80, the data itself extends up to ~94%. This phrasing could mislead a reader into thinking the maximum value on the y-axis is 80.

The description omits a key feature of the plot: the intersection of the two lines at Iteration 3, where both categories reach an accuracy of approximately 82%. This point is significant as it marks when the 6-digit accuracy surpasses the 5-digit accuracy.
The description does not mention the presence of a legend in the top-left corner of the plot, which is used to identify the two data series.
